result.reason: The clause still contains no aggregate liability cap, so it reaches neither the preferred cap nor the fallback 12-month-fees cap. Although the indirect/consequential-damages exclusion is mutual and gross negligence and wilful misconduct are carved out, the required fallback carve-outs for indemnification and confidentiality are not clearly established because Sections 13 and 14 are unidentified. It also omits the payment-obligations clarification and adds unnecessary uncapped categories and remedy provisions, including a one-sided carve-out for Sparkling data, death/personal injury, tangible-property damage, and referenced express remedies. These additions materially alter the risk allocation beyond what is needed. The drafting is generally readable, but the scope depends on unexplained cross-references and does not implement the core cap requirement.
